positive_snippets: pretty great hotel, and awesome atmosphere, cleaniness of rooms and the service too. loved it.
negative_snippets: Please don't go there after booking in OYO or any such apps. These guys won't accept bookings through any app. After reaching there 20km they disappointed me that they don't give rooms at the rate shown in OYO app. The strategy is that the customers from OYO will be forced to pay the amount they asked due to the long travel to that hotel. Moreover the hotel is located inside the Bhawana industrial area and if you reach there after 8pm definitely you will not get any bus or auto to come out from there . So you will pay the amount requested by them and have to adjust with the poor facilities provided.
